gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-nko: Wrench-bent curves, all one line weight. Baumans loudly claims the top spot, while Noto Sans NKo keeps its see-through openings quiet and modern underneath.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Noto Sans NKo Unjoined reads approachably, with wide openings on its small letters and nothing fussy about them. Baumans makes the statement; the body font carries the details.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Tubular, confident, a bit odd. Noto Sans Shavian lets its loose, unknotted curves unspool in a plain sans way, so a longer passage moves along smoothly beneath Baumans.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ojuju: Ojuju brings a lightly flexed contrast and wide, barely curled s curves, friendly and current. Baumans, with no thick-thin pulse, wants bigger sizes, and Ojuju is happy staying modest.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-overpass: Overpass keeps its strokes consistent within every word, and its e never clogs into a blot. Make Baumans small and its commanding presence thins out, while a large Overpass loses its sense of restraint.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-palanquin: Palanquin curves its letters around wide, unclosed mouths, a plain sans with a contemporary lean. Yet Baumans, drawn with a unit-width stroke throughout, supplies the pair's strongest quality: a distinct, commanding voice.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-philosopher: Philosopher has curves full of daylight and soft shifts in thickness that never turn stark. Baumans looks bent from a single wire, and that sharp difference in line is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-pontano-sans: Pontano Sans reads openly, its c terminals swung wide and friendly. Yet Baumans, drawn as if by ruler and compass, is the one to enlarge, so let the body text stay modest.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-pt-sans: Bent tubing meets open arcs. Baumans pushes its commanding, distinctive shapes forward, but PT Sans keeps its c forms inviting, so a long page of sans text goes down easily.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-quattrocento-sans: Quattrocento Sans leaves enough gap that c never collapses into o. Quattrocento Sans can stay at a modest size, since Baumans has no thin strokes vanishing in glare to worry about.
